name: Polaris
tagline: The North Star — a Cepheid beacon almost directly above Earth's axis.
history: Polaris sits within a degree of the north celestial pole — the sky's pivot around which all other stars appear to wheel. It is a Cepheid variable, a supergiant that pulses over four days, and a triple system whose tight inner pair Hubble only resolved in 2006. It was not always the pole star (Thuban held the post for ancient Egypt) and will hand the title to Errai in ~4,000 years as Earth's axis precesses.
